observation: Top of the page: on the original, the first ~1300px screenshot slice is blank white and no header or nav is visible. The AI-built page has a visible 65px white header bar with a hairline bottom border, semi-transparent white (rgba 255,255,255,0.95) and backdrop blur, with the logo on the left and nav plus CTA on the right.

Logo: on the original, merchant_savvy_purple.svg renders tiny (48×11 at x=419) and a 250px variant is hidden at 0×0. The AI-built page uses the same purple SVG logo at 149×34 in the header and a white version at 140×32 in the footer.

H1: the original's only h1 has empty text (38px, weight 600, Open Sans, navy rgb(0,37,58)). The AI-built h1 reads 'Payment Processing Made Simple (& Cheaper)' at 60px weight 700 in system-ui, near-black rgb(28,29,46), with '(& Cheaper)' in an indigo span for two-tone emphasis.

Heading outline: the original runs empty h1, then two h3s with template-like labels ('Desktop - Organic (+ types)', 'Mobile - IMS with Types'), then three h2s. The AI-built page has a clean h1 followed by three h2s and no h3. Both share the h2 topics Payment Processing and Finance & Banking; the third is 'Research & Stats' on the original and 'Research & Statistics' on the AI-built page.

Semantic markup: the original is built from generic containers (405 divs, 15 sections, 4 navs) with no header, main or footer element, and its footer text is not in a footer landmark. The AI-built page uses header, one nav, main, 6 sections, footer and an address element.
Hidden form controls: the original DOM has 174 inputs, 113 labels, 5 selects with 55 options, 3 forms and 3 iframes, none of them visible. The AI-built page has no forms.

Code weight: the original ships 95 scripts, 44 stylesheets, 9 style blocks and 304 inline style attributes, with page-builder classes (416 unique, 0.002 tailwind-like). The AI-built page has 0 scripts, 1 stylesheet, 0 inline styles and 23 unique hand-written semantic classes (0.052 tailwind-like).
Body text: the original sets it at 14px with a 25.2px line-height in mid-grey rgb(146,146,146). The AI-built page sets it at 16px with a 25.6px line-height in near-black rgb(28,29,46).

Font families: the original mixes Open Sans (534), roboto/Roboto (438/140, inconsistent casing) and calibri (134), plus the icon fonts Font Awesome 5 Free and eicons. The AI-built page uses a single system-ui sans stack (170 elements) and no icon fonts.
Section h2s: the original sets them at 28px weight 500 in a lighter dark-grey. The AI-built page sets them at 36px weight 700 in dark navy.

Link-section layout: on the original, the heading and paragraph sit in a left column (x≈160–515) with two link columns beside them at x≈540 and x≈920. On the AI-built page, the h2 and a ~640px intro sit above a 3-column grid of tiles with ~14px gaps.

Link styling: the original uses plain cyan rgb(19,175,240) text links with Font Awesome chevron-right bullets and tight ~25px spacing. The AI-built page uses white rounded tiles (337×60) with thin grey borders, a 16px medium label and an 18×18 right-arrow SVG.

On both pages, the content is mainly a directory-like hub of keyword-style topical links (e.g. Merchant Account Providers, Card Readers & Machines) with only a short descriptive paragraph per section.

The AI-built tile grids have uneven last rows: Payment Processing ends with 2 tiles in a 3-column grid, and the long 'Charity & Community Bank Accounts' label wraps, making that tile 85px tall against the 60px standard.

Background palette: the original is mostly white, with pale blue-grey rgb(218,228,232) and accent fills in green rgb(69,187,92), violet-blue rgb(71,55,255) and orange-red rgb(249,66,19) that are not visible in the screenshots. The AI-built page uses a single-hue indigo scheme: rgb(43,44,145) accent, lavender rgb(241,241,250) tint and deep indigo rgb(30,34,140).

Text colours: the original uses mid grey rgb(146,146,146) and darker grey rgb(105,105,105) for most text, with cyan rgb(19,175,240) links and a little navy. The AI-built page uses near-black navy rgb(28,29,46) for text, grey-violet rgb(90,92,117) for secondary text, and indigo rgb(43,44,145) as the link/accent colour.

Visible section backgrounds: the original shows only white, with no colour blocks. The AI-built page alternates white sections with a full-bleed pale lavender band for Finance & Banking and a deep indigo footer.

Research section image cards: the original shows small 208×139 thumbnails (charts.jpg 'UK SMEs', payment-fraud-stats.jpg 'Payment Fraud') with small grey captions in a horizontal row. The AI-built page shows the same two illustrations, one isometric and one hooded-hacker, as large ~508×339 bordered, rounded cards with bold caption bars.
On the AI-built page, each research card is a single anchor wrapping the img and a caption span, with a border and rounded corners that clip the image. Neither page uses figure/figcaption.

Mobile Payments, Remote Working and Mobile Ecommerce: on the original these are image cards whose images are broken, with alt text spilling and captions displaced far down the page. On the AI-built page they are a row of three plain text link tiles below the image cards.
The original's stat images are unloaded but keep 1024px-wide boxes on a 228px step, so they overlap heavily (up to 546,852 px²). The AI-built page has no image overlaps.
The original has a ~500px blank vertical gap between the Research & Stats cards and the footer, caused by broken image boxes reserving height.

Footer: the original's footer is a plain small grey legal block on white (copyright 2021, company number, Reading address) with cyan Privacy/Terms links, left at x≈150. The AI-built footer is a full-width deep indigo rgb(30,34,140) block with a white logo, company and address text, right-aligned Privacy/Terms links, a divider and a '© All rights reserved 2021.' line.

Payment-method logo strip (528×23 image): on the original it closes the page at the bottom left (x=171) in greyscale. On the AI-built page it sits centred in its own section with an 'Accepted payment types' caption and a hairline top border, above the footer.
The AI-built hero has an extra pale 300×50 payment-scheme logo row (Visa, Mastercard, Apple Pay, contactless) below the CTA buttons.
Corner radius: the original is mostly square (1179 at 0, 81 at 1–7px, 6 at 8–15px). The AI-built page has 142 square elements and 28 at 8–15px (8px buttons, tiles, cards). Neither has pill shapes.

Effects: the original has 12 box-shadows, 2 gradients, no blur, 377 transitions and 6 transforms. The AI-built page has 3 shadows (on the stat cards), 1 gradient, 1 backdrop blur, 20 transitions and 0 transforms. Neither page uses animations.
Layout technique: the original uses only flexbox (179 flex, 0 grid). The AI-built page mixes flex (24) with CSS grid (5) for the stat, tile and image-card layouts.

Calls to action: the original has no button-styled CTAs (primary_button null) and uses chevron text links. The AI-built page has a solid indigo 'Get a quote' header button (8px radius, 8px 16px padding) and hero CTAs: a solid 'Compare quotes' and an outlined 'Explore topics' (56px tall). Both pages have 0 <button> elements.

Navigation: the original has 4 nav elements, 105 anchors and 227 li, but none of the menus are visible. The AI-built page has one visible nav with three text links plus the CTA, and 33 anchors in total.

Image count: the original has 66 img tags, most hidden or unloaded at 0×0 (carrier logos, terminals, forms). The AI-built page has 6 images: logos, payment strips and two illustrations. Its hero is text-only.

Alt text: both pages have no missing alt. The original's alts are generic or builder-prefixed ('Homepage (New Design) retail', 'Terminal 5 300x262 1'). The AI-built page's alts are descriptive ('Visa, Mastercard, Android Pay, Apple Pay and contactless', 'Merchant Savvy').
ARIA and skip link: the original has 96 aria attributes. The AI-built page has 22 aria attributes plus an off-screen 'Skip to content' link as its first element.

Head metadata: the original has a full OG/Twitter/robots set, 1 JSON-LD block, a generator meta and the title 'Payment Processing & Merchant Services'. The AI-built page has only charset, viewport and description, no JSON-LD, and the title 'Merchant Savvy – Payment Processing Made Simple (& Cheaper)', which mirrors its h1.
Both pages declare lang en-GB. The AI-built copy uses British spelling ('centres').

Copy volume and tone: the original has 131 visible words of short descriptive copy with no slogan. The AI-built page has 226 words with a benefit-led headline ('Made Simple (& Cheaper)') and 'independent' positioning.
Neither page uses exclamation marks or em dashes. The original has 1 emoji-class character; the AI-built page has 0.

Canvas and content column: the original's content starts at x=160 on a 1868px canvas, spans to x≈1450 and leaves the right third empty. The AI-built page uses a ~1040px left-aligned container at x=200 on a 1440px canvas with even side margins.
Both pages have generous vertical rhythm with large white padding between section blocks: about 204px between section starts on the original, and about 70–80px between sections on the AI-built page.

Page structure: the original has no hero or banner; visible content begins directly with the link sections. The AI-built page opens with a hero (eyebrow, h1, subhead, CTAs) and a stats strip before the link sections, giving six stacked sections.
The AI-built hero has a small uppercase, letter-spaced indigo eyebrow label: 'INDEPENDENT COMPARISON & ADVICE'.
The AI-built hero has a single-line ~20px grey-slate subhead below the headline.
The AI-built hero background is a faint lavender-to-white gradient that ends with a hard edge at y≈595.

The AI-built page has a row of three white, bordered, softly shadowed stat cards that lead with an indigo figure ('90%', '1 route', '0 sales agents') above grey description text. The cards overlap the end of the hero.
